d: Real Madrid produced a stunning second-half comeback to thrash PSV Eindhoven 5-1 in their UEFA Champions League league phase clash. After Ivan Perišić's first-half penalty gave PSV the lead, Los Blancos turned the game around through goals from Federico Valverde, Jude Bellingham and Kylian Mbappé. Mbappé completed his brace late in the match before Vinícius Júnior added a fifth as Real Madrid overwhelmed the Dutch side. The emphatic victory was powered by a relentless attacking display after the break, with all five Madrid goals coming in the second half.
